title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: combining a replenishment transfer amount and raising it to the tier minimum
content:
## Scope

This rule applies when the owner of a Savings & Money Market Accounts account asks for a monthly automatic transfer that puts back what overdraft protection took from the savings account in a statement cycle, together with the withdrawal fee amount the account bears for that cycle. It fixes how the two figures combine into the monthly amount.

## Policy clause

The monthly amount is the overdraft figure and the withdrawal fee amount the account bears added together, rounded half-up to the cent, and raised to the tier's minimum automatic transfer amount when that total is below it.

## Order of the calculation

1. Add the overdraft figure and the withdrawal fee amount the account bears.
2. Compare that total with the tier's minimum automatic transfer amount.
3. If the total is below the minimum, the monthly amount is the minimum, rounded half-up to the cent.
4. Otherwise, the monthly amount is the total, rounded half-up to the cent.

The minimum is tested against the combined total, never against the overdraft figure alone.

## Worked cases (hypothetical figures; the USD 40.00 minimum is illustrative, not a tier value)

| Overdraft figure | Withdrawal fee amount the account bears | Total | Compared with USD 40.00 | Monthly amount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| USD 184.68 | USD 8.00 | USD 192.68 | not below | USD 192.68 |
| USD 18.40 | USD 8.00 | USD 26.40 | below | USD 40.00 |
| USD 40.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 40.00 | not below (equal) | USD 40.00 |
| USD 33.335 | USD 8.00 | USD 41.335 | not below | USD 41.34 (half a cent rounds up) |

## Points of judgement

**Wrong reading:** "Raise the overdraft figure to the minimum first, then add the fee amount." With USD 18.40 and USD 8.00 that would give USD 48.00. **Correct basis:** add first, then raise the total: USD 26.40 is raised to USD 40.00.

**Wrong reading:** "The monthly amount can be below the tier minimum when little was taken." **Correct basis:** a total below the minimum is raised to the minimum.
